newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: United Overseas Land incorporates units.
newsitem.headline: United Overseas Land incorporates units.

text.p: United Overseas Land (UOL) Ltd said on Monday it had incorporated two subsidiaries Novena Square Development Pte Ltd and Novena Square Investments Pte Ltd.
UOL said in a statement that Novena Square Development has an authorised capital of Singapore $5,050,000.
Its main business would be to develop a commercial site in central Singapore and to market or sell the strata units comprising about 30 percent of the project.

Novena Square Investments has an authorised capital of S$300 million. Its main business would be to develop the project and to hold for long-term investment the strata units comprising about 70 percent of the project, it said.
